lead: Sharp for as long as we forge.

Knives made in our workshop – bought from us or forged by you in one of our courses – are resharpened free of charge, as often as needed, for as long as Messermanufaktur Ulbrich exists. A care booklet and a care product are included free of charge.

items.x: Care instructions in a small booklet
A care product, free of charge

Professional resharpening of the cutting edge, free of charge and without a limit on how often. Repairs, replacement parts or fixing damage are not included; paid repairs are only carried out after a separate agreement.
The guarantee starts when you receive the knife and applies worldwide, as long as the knife can lawfully be shipped there and back. "Lifetime" means as long as our workshop exists as a business.

Email info@messermanufaktur-ulbrich.de with a short description of the knife. We send you the address and the process – or drop the knife off in person by arrangement. The sharpening is free; you pay the shipping both ways and any import charges.

The sharpening guarantee is a voluntary promise in addition to your statutory warranty rights for defects, which remain unaffected and free of charge. The binding German terms are on the page [Lebenslange Schliff-Garantie](/garantie/).

faq.q: How often can I have my knife resharpened?
faq.a: As often as needed – there is no limit, for as long as Messermanufaktur Ulbrich exists.

faq.q: Does it apply to knives I forged in a course?
faq.a: Yes. Knives forged in one of our courses are covered just like knives bought from us.
The sharpening itself is free. You pay the shipping to us and back, plus any import charges when sending from abroad.
